correctness.rationale: Four exhaustive same-letter run-pair cases using first-next occurrence/LCE establish every endpoint for all positive a,b,c, including equality c=a and boundary cases a=b=c=1. Counts, rational series and sharp extremum follow by disjoint endpoint enumeration and geometric sums. Independent direct-border and next-occurrence implementations agree with full predicted endpoint sets in 216 and 5,832 parameter triples respectively. Bounded checks are corroboration, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The fixed five-run palindromic family is the first symmetric run class with three same-letter zero runs; its center-gap threshold changes which spanning repeated borders survive maximality. An exact parametric output size for nontrivial compressed strings, a rational distribution of all parameters and sharp maximum floor(2n/3)+4 at every n>=6 advance the structural understanding of output-sensitive MCS enumeration rather than merely checking a tiny case.
